subject: Cloud Computing
title: The $600 Billion Market
description: A micro-lesson that makes The $600 Billion Market usable.

hook.text: Global cloud spending exceeded $600 billion in 2023. By 2030, forecasts predict it will double.

buildup.text: Cloud infrastructure, SaaS, and PaaS combined represent one of the fastest-growing sectors in tech.

discovery.text: Only about 30% of enterprise workloads are in the cloud today. The migration wave still has years to run.

twist.text: AI is accelerating cloud spending. Training and running AI models requires cloud-scale compute that no one owns.

climax.text: Cloud computing isn't a mature market. It's still in the growth phase, with decades of expansion ahead.

punchline.text: Six hundred billion dollars. And we're still early.

quiz.question: What percentage of enterprise workloads are currently in the cloud?
options: About 30%, with significant room for growth
Over 90%, with the migration nearly complete
Less than 5%, with most companies rejecting cloud

details.summary: The global cloud computing market exceeds $600 billion annually and continues growing at over 20% per year. Cloud infrastructure, platform services, and SaaS collectively represent one of the largest and fastest-growing technology markets in history.
details.whyItMatters: The size and growth rate of the cloud market signal that cloud computing is not a trend but a fundamental economic shift. Understanding the market helps contextualize provider strategies and competition.
takeaways: The cloud market exceeds $600 billion annually
Growth rate remains above 20 percent year over year
Infrastructure, platform, and SaaS segments all contribute

faq.question: What is the largest segment of cloud spending?
faq.answer: SaaS is the largest segment by total spending, as it includes all cloud-delivered software from email to CRM. Infrastructure as a Service, dominated by AWS, Azure, and GCP, is the fastest-growing segment and the foundation all other cloud services build upon.

faq.question: How much do enterprises spend on cloud?
faq.answer: Large enterprises typically spend millions to hundreds of millions on cloud annually. Some hyperscale customers spend over a billion dollars per year with a single cloud provider. Gartner estimates that over 65 percent of application software spending is now cloud-based.
